title: Contact Details Scraper
description: Extract emails, phones, WhatsApp, addresses & 14 social platforms from any website. Supports direct URLs AND search queries.

startUrls.title: Start URLs
startUrls.description: Use this field when the user provides specific website URLs or domain URLs to extract contacts from. Each URL is crawled independently and returns one consolidated contact record per domain. Do NOT use this when the user describes a business type or industry — use searchQueries for that.

searchQueries.title: Search Queries
searchQueries.description: Use this field when the user provides a business type, niche, or location query instead of specific URLs. Examples: 'dentists in Miami Florida', 'web design agencies London', 'plumbers Chicago'. The actor searches DuckDuckGo and extracts contacts from the top results. Do NOT use this when the user provides direct URLs — use startUrls for that.

maxPagesPerDomain.title: Max Pages per Domain
maxPagesPerDomain.description: Maximum number of pages to crawl per domain. Higher values find more contacts but cost more. Contact/About/Team pages are crawled first. Recommended: 5–15.

maxDepth.title: Max Link Depth
maxDepth.description: How many links deep to follow from the start URL. Depth 1 = only the homepage + directly linked pages. Depth 2 = one more level. Increase for large sites.

maxResults.title: Max Domains (Results)
maxResults.description: Maximum number of domains to extract contacts from and save to the dataset. Each domain = one output record. When using searchQueries, this caps how many websites from search results are processed.

proxyConfig.title: Restricted access control
proxyConfig.description: VibeLeads restriction: enablement is unsupported. Verify a documented disabled/direct/public mode and actual build behavior before execution; otherwise decline this route. See the source access gate.

x-vibeleads-execution-review: required; schema inspection is not execution permission
x-vibeleads-contact-use-review: required; company discovery and contact stages are distinct
